title: 第2233章 敖轩摊牌第2232章 龙皇失踪
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
当今龙皇敖煌，在陈凡印象中，是做事及其谨慎的！
毕竟陈凡的龙族分身一直在龙族族地修行，与敖煌也相处了数十载，此番忽然消失，肯定是遇到了大麻烦！
“龙皇失踪，群龙无首，正是他最好的夺权之机！”
“这短短两月之内，敖轩暗中动作不断，已经在蠢蠢欲动了，我估计它随时会动手，我们必须要尽快动身。”
“敖轩知道龙皇归来，自己的所有计划全都会落空，它等不了了。”
洛千凝点点头：“好，那我们现在就走！”
陈凡转头看向霍凌霄，拱手正色道：“霍阁主，千凝与我有要事，需即刻动身前往万妖仙域，我的几位朋友，还请阁主多多照拂。”
“小友放心，若有需要帮忙之处，我剑阁内众高手，任凭你挑选。”霍凌霄保证道。
话音落下，剑阁众仙纷纷昂首挺胸，想要配陈凡和洛千凝一同前去。
可陈凡却摆摆手，云梦仙海内尚有魔道暗中涌动，这里也要小心！
龙族这次发生的内斗，陈凡甚至怀疑是神族提前动手。
不过就在陈凡婉拒剑阁好意后，一道身影出现在他身边，正是李宝臻。
“仙师，我与你们同去。”李宝臻说道。
“好！”陈凡毫不犹豫点点头。
虽说此行凶险，但李宝臻乃是陈凡挚友，他没有理由拒绝对方。
随后，陈凡等三人不敢有半分耽搁，以最快速度横渡仙域，疾驰而去。
半年岁月，弹指即过。
一路上，陈凡时时刻刻与龙族分身保持神魂相连，实时接收龙族族地传来的所有讯息，每一则消息，都让三人心中的沉郁愈发浓重。
龙皇敖煌失踪两月有余，直至此刻，整整八月光阴流逝，依旧杳无音信，遍寻龙族全境、祖地秘境、深海禁地，无迹可寻，如同彻底湮灭于天地之间。
八个月的时间，龙皇依旧不知所踪。

就在最近，两道隐匿的无上威压，笼罩龙族上空，震慑整片龙族族地。
两大神王同时现身龙族，摆明了要扶持敖轩、颠覆龙族正统、掌控万妖仙域局势！
得知这一讯息的瞬间，赶路途中的三人，神色彻底冰冷。
“神族，果然明目张胆入局了，敖轩它真敢这么做！”陈凡目光凝重。
三道身影骤然提速，冲破最后一层仙域壁垒，轰鸣一声，踏入满目烽火、动荡不安的万妖仙域！
content_en:
In Chen Fan's impression, the current Dragon Emperor Ao Huang is extremely cautious in doing things!
After all, Chen Fan's Dragon Clan clone has been practicing in the Dragon Clan and has been with Ao Huang for decades. If he suddenly disappeared this time, he must be in big trouble!
"The Dragon King is missing and the dragons are leaderless. This is his best chance to seize power!"
"In these short two months, Ao Xuan has been secretly moving continuously and is already ready to make a move. I estimate that it will take action at any time. We must leave as soon as possible."
"Ao Xuan knows that when the Dragon Emperor returns, all his plans will come to nothing. He can't wait any longer."
Luo Qianning nodded: "Okay, let's leave now!"
Chen Fan turned to look at Huo Lingxiao, cupped his hands and said sternly: "Pavilion Master Huo, Qian Ning and I have something important to do, and we need to leave for the Ten Thousand Demons Immortal Realm immediately. I ask the Pavilion Master to take care of my few friends."
"Don't worry, little friend, if you need help, I have all the experts in the sword pavilion at your disposal," Huo Lingxiao promised.
After the words fell, all the immortals in Jiange held their heads high and wanted to accompany Chen Fan and Luo Qianning.
But Chen Fan waved his hand, there are still evil ways secretly surging in the Yunmeng Immortal Sea, so be careful here!
Chen Fan even suspected that the Gods had taken action in advance of the internal fighting among the Dragon Clan.
But just after Chen Fan declined Jiange's kindness, a figure appeared next to him, it was Li Baozhen.
"Master Immortal, I will go with you." Li Baozhen said.
"Okay!" Chen Fan nodded without hesitation.
Although this trip is dangerous, Li Baozhen is Chen Fan's best friend and he has no reason to reject him.
Afterwards, Chen Fan and the other three people did not dare to delay for a moment, crossed the Immortal Realm at the fastest speed, and galloped away.
Half a year passes in a snap of the fingers.
Along the way, Chen Fan maintained a spiritual connection with the Dragon Clan's clone at all times, receiving all the messages from the Dragon Clan in real time. Every piece of news made the three of them feel more depressed.
Dragon King Ao Huang has been missing for more than two months. Until now, eight months have passed by, and there is still no news. He has searched all over the Dragon Clan, the secret realm of the ancestral land, and the deep sea forbidden land. No trace can be found, as if he was completely annihilated between heaven and earth.
Eight months later, the Dragon King was still missing.
Just recently, two hidden supreme pressures enveloped the sky above the Dragon Clan, shocking the entire Dragon Clan land.
The two god kings appeared in the Dragon Clan at the same time, making it clear that they wanted to support Ao Xuan, subvert the Dragon Clan's orthodoxy, and control the situation in the Ten Thousand Demons Immortal Realm!
The moment they heard the news, the three people on the way looked completely cold.
"The God Clan has indeed entered the situation blatantly. Ao Xuan really dares to do this!" Chen Fan looked solemnly.
The three figures suddenly accelerated, broke through the last layer of the fairyland barrier, and with a roar, stepped into the turbulent Ten Thousand Monsters Fairyland full of flames!
